reason: The hypothesis relies on carbon doping improving dynamic properties in a specific refractory alloy, but the cited evidence only discusses a different alloy system (NiCoCr) and a different refractory alloy (NbTaTiV) without interstitial doping. No evidence supports carbon solubility, hardening, or shear localization delay in HfZrTiTa0.53 or similar refractory high-entropy alloys.
